name: Blood Drain AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: A tiny spark of Nin's will drains the blood from living intruders.
disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) to vandalize the space, or DC 24 Religion (expert) to pray to a god for passage, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the magical energy
reset: The trap automatically deactivates after 1 minute. It resets in 1 hour.
routine: (1 action) On its initiative, the trap continues to drain blood, dealing (2d6+8) Void Damage damage to all living creatures in the room (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a failure, a creature increases the value of their drained condition by 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the room of their own accord

Effect The trap drains the blood from all living creatures in the room, which manifests as a bloody mist in the air. All living creatures in the room are dealt (2d6+8) Void Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a failure, a creature increases the value of their drained condition by 1. The trap then rolls initiative.
